title: WireMessage
description: Canonical Termivoa protocol v1 message union.

agentOption.title: AgentOption
agentOption.description: One answer the broker can send. Label is terminal output: render it as text only. The broker chooses the keys from the current screen; the client sends only the option index.

agentQuestion.title: AgentQuestion
agentQuestion.description: A recognized prompt. id is a stable hash of the session generation, text, the full dialog context (of which detail is the capped display form) and option labels; input.answer must repeat it. text, detail and labels are terminal output: render them as text only. detail says what is being approved (tool, command, file), one line per newline.

agentStatus.title: AgentStatus
agentStatus.description: Broker-computed activity of a running session. question is present exactly when state is waiting. stateSince is the RFC 3339 time of the last change of state or question. afterWork is true only on idle, when this idle ended a working period in this broker's lifetime ("your turn"); it is absent otherwise and resets when work starts again. workedSeconds is the total time in the working state during this broker's lifetime, up to now; phones compare it with the value they saw last.

previewPort.title: PreviewPort
previewPort.description: A TCP port that a process in this session's process tree listens on, on a loopback or wildcard address, verified by the broker from the operating system. since is the RFC 3339 time the broker first saw it. The phone may open it through the gateway's separate preview origin; see docs/preview.md.

workingDirectory.description: The live working folder of a running session: an absolute path (POSIX or Windows) read by the broker from the operating system or from an OSC 7 / OSC 9;9 report in terminal output. It is display text only; never open, link or execute it. Absent when unknown. See docs/live-folder.md.

previewPorts.description: Previewable ports of a running session, sorted by port, unique. Absent when there are none.

sessionAttachPayload.title: SessionAttachPayload
sessionAttachPayload.description: Empty attaches a full viewer. thumbnail attaches a read-only viewer (no control or input) whose screen frames the broker coalesces to at most maxUpdatesPerSecond; snapshots, history notices and session state are not throttled. Send thumbnail only to a computer whose protocolRevision supports it.

inputAnswerPayload.title: InputAnswerPayload
inputAnswerPayload.description: Answers the current agent question. The broker rejects it with question_changed unless questionId is still the detected question, then writes that option's keys once.

changesListPayload.title: ChangesListPayload
changesListPayload.description: Asks for the uncommitted changes of the git repository that holds the session's working folder.

changesFilePayload.title: ChangesFilePayload
changesFilePayload.description: Asks for the diff of one path from the latest changes.summary, relative to the repository root.

changesSummaryPayload.title: ChangesSummaryPayload
changesSummaryPayload.description: ready: files lists the changes against HEAD, plus untracked files that git does not ignore. not_git: the folder is not in a repository. unavailable: git is missing or failed.

changesPatchPayload.title: ChangesPatchPayload
changesPatchPayload.description: ready: lines hold the unified diff without file headers, cut at a byte budget (truncated). binary, missing (no longer changed) and unavailable carry no lines.

changesCommitPayload.title: ChangesCommitPayload
changesCommitPayload.description: Controller only. Commits exactly these paths from the latest changes.summary (paths not in a fresh listing are refused) with this message. The repository's own commit hooks run, as with any git commit.

changesPushPayload.title: ChangesPushPayload
changesPushPayload.description: Controller only. Pushes the current branch to its upstream, or to origin with a new upstream when it has none. Never forces.

changesCommittedPayload.title: ChangesCommittedPayload
changesCommittedPayload.description: committed: commit is the short hash. nothing: no selected path had changes. failed: output holds the last lines git or a hook printed.

changesPushedPayload.title: ChangesPushedPayload
changesPushedPayload.description: pushed: branch is the pushed branch, and url is an https link that the remote printed (for example GitHub's new pull request page), when there was one. no_remote: nowhere to push. failed: output holds the last lines git printed.

tasksListPayload.title: TasksListPayload
tasksListPayload.description: Asks for the commands a project defines, read from files in the session's project folder. Nothing runs.

tasksListedPayload.title: TasksListedPayload
tasksListedPayload.description: ready: tasks lists the project's commands, ready to type in the project folder (folder), most useful kinds first. none: no known project file. unavailable: the folder could not be read.

branchesListPayload.title: BranchesListPayload
branchesListPayload.description: Asks for the branches of the git repository that holds the session's working folder (the same folder as changes.list), to pick the base of a new worktree.

branchRef.title: BranchRef
branchRef.description: One branch. name is the short name git prints (main, origin/main). remote is true for a remote-tracking branch (refs/remotes).

branchesListedPayload.title: BranchesListedPayload
branchesListedPayload.description: ready: branches lists the local branches (refs/heads) first, then the remote-tracking branches (refs/remotes, without */HEAD), each group sorted by name, at most 200 (truncated). repo is the base name of the main repository root, also when the folder is in a linked worktree. defaultBranch is the suggested base: the local branch that refs/remotes/origin/HEAD names, else that remote branch (origin/main), else main, else master, else the current branch; absent when none exists. current is the checked-out branch, absent when HEAD is detached. not_git: the folder is not in a repository. unavailable: git is missing or failed. Only ready carries repo, defaultBranch, current and branches.

worktreeRemovePayload.title: WorktreeRemovePayload
worktreeRemovePayload.description: Controller only. Removes the git worktree the session started in (only a Termivoa worktree, created with a session create worktree request) with git worktree remove, then ends the session. Without force, a worktree with changes or untracked files is kept and the reply is dirty. The branch is always kept. One commit, push or remove runs per session at a time.

worktreeRemovedPayload.title: WorktreeRemovedPayload
worktreeRemovedPayload.description: removed: the worktree folder is gone, the branch is kept, and the session ends next. dirty: force was false and the worktree has changes; nothing was removed. failed: nothing more happens; output holds the last lines git printed or why it was refused.

filesListPayload.title: FilesListPayload
filesListPayload.description: Asks for the entries of one folder in the files root: the git top level of the session's working folder (the same folder as changes.list) when that folder is in a repository, else the folder itself. path is relative to the root with / separators; an empty path is the root. An absolute path or a .. segment gets an invalid_request error and the stream stays open. Read-only: any viewer may ask, no control lease is needed. One files request runs per viewer at a time; another gets limit_exceeded.

fileEntry.title: FileEntry
fileEntry.description: One folder entry. name is the base name (bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD). kind is dir, file (a regular file), link (a symlink that points outside the files root or nowhere; a symlink inside the root shows as its target's kind) or other (device, socket, pipe). size is the file size in bytes, only for file.

filesListedPayload.title: FilesListedPayload
filesListedPayload.description: ready: entries lists the folder, folders first, then by name ignoring case, at most 1000 (truncated). A .git entry is never listed. not_found: the folder does not exist, is outside the root, or is inside .git. not_dir: path is not a folder. unavailable: the root could not be opened or read. root is the absolute files root with / separators (C:/Users/me/app on Windows), absent only when the root is not known. path is the normalized relative path with / separators (empty for the root). Only ready carries entries.

filesReadPayload.title: FilesReadPayload
filesReadPayload.description: Asks for the text of one file in the files root (see files.list). path is relative to the root with / separators. An absolute path or a .. segment gets an invalid_request error.

filesContentPayload.title: FilesContentPayload
filesContentPayload.description: ready: text is the file as UTF-8. At most 262144 bytes are read; a longer file is cut at the last line break inside them (truncated). The text is also cut, the same way, if its JSON form would pass 786432 bytes. Invalid UTF-8, and a NUL byte after the first 8192 bytes, is replaced with U+FFFD when it is at most 1% of the bytes read. binary: a NUL byte in the first 8192 bytes, or more invalid UTF-8 than that. too_large: the file is over 52428800 bytes (50 MiB) and was not opened. not_found: the file does not exist, is outside the root (a symlink that escapes), or is inside .git. not_file: a folder or another kind of non-regular file. unavailable: the file could not be read. size is the file size in bytes, for ready, binary and too_large. Only ready carries text.

filesSearchPayload.title: FilesSearchPayload
filesSearchPayload.description: Asks for the files in the files root (see files.list) whose relative path contains query, ignoring case. In a repository the candidates are the tracked files and the untracked files git does not ignore. Outside one, a walk of at most 20000 entries that skips .git and node_modules.

filesFoundPayload.title: FilesFoundPayload
filesFoundPayload.description: ready: paths are the matching relative paths with / separators, names that match first, then shorter paths, then by path, at most 200. truncated: more paths matched, or the candidates were cut (git output limit, time limit or the walk limit). unavailable: the root could not be read or git failed. Only ready carries paths.

chatCursor.description: Opaque position in one chat history, issued by the host in a chat.page. The host accepts only a cursor it issued for the current historyId.

chatHistoryId.description: Opaque identity of one chat history (one transcript file as linked). A new historyId means the client drops every block it holds and pages again.

chatOpenPayload.title: ChatOpenPayload
chatOpenPayload.description: Revision 8 (docs/chat-view.md). Starts or joins the chat of the attached session: the host answers chat.state and, when linked, a chat.page with the latest blocks, at most limit turns. Read-only: any non-thumbnail viewer may ask (a thumbnail gets not_controller). Refused with limit_exceeded when a chat request of this viewer or session is running or when opens come too fast. With Chat off the host answers chat.state off and opens no file.

chatReadPayload.title: ChatReadPayload
chatReadPayload.description: Asks for one chat.page after chat.open. before: older blocks than that cursor (at most limit turns). after: newer blocks than that cursor (send it after chat.changed). Exactly one of before and after. A cursor of another historyId, or one the host did not issue, gets history_changed: open again. One chat request runs per viewer and per session at a time; another gets limit_exceeded.

chatLink.description: off: Chat is turned off on this computer. unsupported: no supported agent runs in this session, or this computer cannot read one (Windows). searching: an agent runs but its transcript is not there yet. linked: the transcript is linked and verified. none: linking failed, see reason. ended: the agent exited; the last blocks can still be paged.

chatReason.description: Why link is none. cleared: the agent started a new conversation (/clear) that cannot be linked exactly. several_agents: more than one agent runs in the session. custom_root: the agent's folder was moved (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). no_file: no single transcript matches the agent. format_unknown: the transcript format is not one this host reads. file_refused: the transcript failed a safety check (link, several names, owner or permissions). busy: this computer already follows the most chats it allows (8).

chatStatePayload.title: ChatStatePayload
chatStatePayload.description: The chat link of the session. Sent after chat.open and when the link changes. reason only with none. agent and historyId only with linked or ended. stale: true when chat.changed notices were dropped for this viewer; page again with after.

chatChangedPayload.title: ChatChangedPayload
chatChangedPayload.description: New or changed blocks exist after the last page: ask with chat.read after. Coalesced: at most one is waiting per viewer, at most 4 a second. Carries no chat content.

chatToolResult.title: ChatToolResult
chatToolResult.description: A preview of a tool's output: at most 2048 bytes and 40 lines, masked. bytes is the size of the whole output; truncated when the preview is shorter.

chatTool.title: ChatTool
chatTool.description: One tool call. name is the agent's tool name (for example Bash, Read, Edit, Task). summary is one line the host derives (the command, the path, the pattern), masked. status: running until a result is seen; unknown when the result could not be read.

status.description: One of running, ok, error, unknown (a pattern, not an enum, so generated Go names stay stable).

chatEdit.title: ChatEdit
chatEdit.description: A file edit by the agent. path is relative to the session's folder, or the base name when outside it. added and removed count lines. hunk is at most 40 lines (each starting with -, + or a space), masked.

chatBlock.title: ChatBlock
chatBlock.description: One normalized chat block. id is stable for this historyId; a block whose id the client already holds replaces it (a tool result updates its call). turn is the id of the user_text that opened the turn. text: user_text and assistant_text (assistant text is markdown: render it sanitized, no raw HTML, no images), status (for example Thought for 14s), compaction and omitted. At most 16384 bytes, masked, without control characters other than tab and line feed; truncatedBytes counts the bytes cut. tool: tool_call and edit. edit: edit only. Thinking text, images, system prompts and sub-agent transcripts are never sent.

chatPagePayload.title: ChatPagePayload
chatPagePayload.description: Blocks of one historyId in file order, at most 200, the whole message at most 262144 bytes. before: cursor for older blocks; absent when the page starts at the beginning of the history. after: cursor for newer blocks. complete: the page reaches the current end of the history; when false, ask again with after at once.
